metadata.user_request: make a simple EMA crossover strategy that uses 30 and 70 periods crossing each other for entry. Open long positions when 30 ema crosses above 70 ema and enter short position when 70 ema crosses below 30 ema. The stop loss should be set 15 pips from entry and take profit should be 70 pips from entry

items.title: Implement Complete EMA Crossover Strategy
items.description: Implement a complete EMA Crossover trading strategy with: (1) Robust data loading and preprocessing from CSV/API, (2) Calculation of 30-period and 70-period Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs), (3) Entry conditions: Open long position when 30 EMA crosses above 70 EMA; Open short position when 70 EMA crosses below 30 EMA, (4) Exit conditions: Implement a 15-pip Stop Loss and a 70-pip Take Profit from the entry price for all positions, (5) A comprehensive backtest runner utilizing the SimBroker adapter. Ensure explicit loop termination conditions, proper error handling, and detailed logging. The strategy must be production-ready and fully testable.
